text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm assembling a concrete plan for tonight's burn-in + bisection on rack g3 (intermittent ECC/Xid). Need slot reservations + brief network isolation window.
kaushik: ok, which nodes specifically? any customer impact window?
maria: target: g3-12..g3-18 (6 nodes). These are already drained of production. No external customers on them but cluster autoscaler may shift load; I'll add a temp capacity guard. plan is non-blocking to other racks.
ashwin: can we avoid a full power-cycle sweep? last time power cycling triggered a PCIe soft-Xid storm.
maria: agreed — prefer controlled thermal cycle + targeted stress tests first. sequence: 1) snapshot NVML+dmesg (store to s3://infra-dumps/g3-12-18/$(date +%s)) 2) run `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ECC,PCI` and collect `dmesg -T | tail -n 200` 3) run 4h `memtest-cliff` + 4h `cuda-kernel-stress` in alternating 30m windows 4) if intermittent Xid reproduces, run bisection removing half the cards (physically or via driver quirk) to locate faulty card 5) thermal soak at 85% fan curve for 2h 6) validation workload: short 1000-token gen loops to hit KV-cache paths.
jen: for step 4 bisection — do we have a playbook for driver quirk disable? i.e., simulate card removal via `devlink`/`driver_unbind`?
ashwin: yes, use `echo 0000:65:00.0 > /sys/bus/pci/devices/.../driver/unbind` to logically isolate. we should test the unbind/rebind on one node first.
sre_lead: schedule note — ops-bot will enforce a 30m blackout for autoscaler during the run and infra-bot will pin capacity+route new jobs away. ops-bot: please post what slot IDs are reserved.
ops-bot: reserved g3-12,g3-13,g3-14,g3-15,g3-16,g3-17 for 22:00-04:00 UTC. autoscaler: pinned. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: preflight tests queued: nvml-snapshot, pci-scan, memtest-cliff x4, kernel-stress x4. Job IDs: 98321-98325.
kaushik: what's the abort criteria? if we see >3 Xid errors in 1h we stop and mark for RMA?
maria: propose: reproducible Xid with same card isolated twice -> mark for RMA. single transient Xid without thermal drift -> continue soak+monitor. we want deterministic repro before RMA to avoid returning healthy cards.
ashwin: cost note — this will burn ~1.9 kWh per node for the window; total ~11.4 kWh. Ops OK?
jen: budget approved for tonight from contingency. pinged finance.
sre_lead: timeline: 21:45 team sync, 22:00 start preflight snapshot, 22:30 memtest cycles begin. I'll be oncall. maria, assign someone to run the bisection steps if repro happens.
maria: assigning ashwin to run unbind/bind bisection and collect logs, kaushik to manage thermal curve and power telemetry, jen to update the incident ticket with outcomes.
ashwin: got it. quick checklist I'm following: `nvml-snapshot`, `nib.sh --stress cuda 30m`, `memtest-cliff --rounds 2`, `dev-unbind-bisect.sh` (test on g3-12 first), `collect-logs.sh | gzip > s3://infra-dumps/...`
jen: please include `dmesg -T | grep -i xid` and kernel oops excerpts in the ticket.
ops-bot: reminder: do not return nodes to service until 24h silent window after last repro or explicit approval from sre_lead.
maria: perfect. if we hit a non-deterministic flake after bisection, we escalate to hardware returns and capture serial console logs for vendor.
ashwin: will also capture BMC sensor deltas (temp, voltage) every 30s during soak.
kaushik: one more ask — add a brief network isolation step for 10m during repro to rule out remote NVMe timeouts as a confounder.
maria: good call. we'll schedule isolation at 00:30 UTC as a single 10m window and annotate the telemetry.
jen: thanks all — will post a short runbook summary to the incident ticket and ping on #eng-infra at 21:40 for final go/no-go. :rocket:
